argv:
set -uo pipefail
r="$1"
while ! pmset -g batt | head -1 | grep -q 'AC Power'; do
  printf 'waiting-for-AC=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$r/s27-final-floorrun.wait.log"
  sleep 60
done
printf 'AC-confirmed=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$r/s27-final-floorrun.wait.log"
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import json,csv,hashlib,shutil,os,datetime
root=Path('"'"'/Users/babar/projects/sdd-kit-public.worktrees/003-gate-round-reduction-and-token-discipline'"'"')
spec=root/'"'"'.specify/specs/003-gate-round-reduction-and-token-discipline'"'"'
v=spec/'"'"'notes/verification'"'"';p=v/'"'"'platforms/ci-20261025-s27-final'"'"'
free=shutil.disk_usage(root).free
assert free>=8*1024**3,'"'"'Less than 8GiB free; floor not started'"'"'
assert not (v/'"'"'lock'"'"').exists(),'"'"'Verification lock exists; floor not started'"'"'
pending=[str(d) for d in (v/'"'"'rounds'"'"').glob('"'"'*/ROUND-*'"'"') if d.is_dir() and not (d/'"'"'report.sha256'"'"').is_file()]
assert not pending,'"'"'Pending round reservation; floor not started: '"'"'+repr(pending)
rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/'"'"'source-mapping.tsv'"'"').open(),delimiter='"'"'\t'"'"'))
for row in rows:
 path=root/row['"'"'path'"'"']
 assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['"'"'raw_sha256'"'"'],'"'"'Frozen source bytes changed: '"'"'+row['"'"'path'"'"']
 assert ('"'"'100755'"'"' if os.access(path,os.X_OK) else '"'"'100644'"'"')==row['"'"'mode'"'"'],'"'"'Frozen mode changed: '"'"'+row['"'"'path'"'"']
print(json.dumps({'"'"'time'"'"':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'"'"'freeBytes'"'"':free,'"'"'mappedFiles'"'"':len(rows),'"'"'pendingReservations'"'"':pending,'"'"'verificationLock'"'"':False,'"'"'sourceBytes'"'"':'"'"'UNCHANGED'"'"'}))
' >> "$r/s27-final-floorrun.wait.log" 2>&1 || exit 96
/usr/bin/time -p -o "$r/s27-final-floorrun.time" bash "$r/s27-final-floor.sh" 1 > "$r/s27-final-floorrun.wrapper.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$r/s27-final-floorrun.wrapper.rc"
exit "$rc"
